summary: This feature adds two-part in-memory reminder functionality to the GraphQL service with clear data models, operations, and validation rules; the structured nature and product decisions call for requirements analysis and breakdown, while the single-repo scope keeps the plan lightweight.

steps.why: The ticket contains product decisions awaiting review and multiple acceptance criteria that need formal Given/When/Then requirements.
steps.instructions: Focus on the product decisions (uniqueness, cascading deletes, validation limits); map each AC to requirements; ensure Part 1/Part 2 ordering is clear.

steps.why: Five product decisions are explicitly flagged for review before technical work begins.
Normalize proposed tickets after TPM approval.
The work splits into Part 1 (lists) and Part 2 (reminders) with a dependency, requiring ordered breakdown into implementable stories.
steps.instructions: Create one story for reminder lists (Part 1) and one for reminders (Part 2); ensure Part 2 depends on Part 1; each story covers its mutations, queries, validation, and tests.

steps.why: Each story needs concrete implementation details: in-memory data structure choices, GraphQL schema definitions, and validation logic.
steps.instructions: Specify the in-memory store design (dictionaries vs classes), GraphQL type definitions, resolver signatures, and validation flows for each operation.

steps.why: Nine acceptance criteria with edge cases (duplicates, blanks, limits, past dates) need explicit test cases mapped 1:1.
steps.instructions: Map each AC to test cases; cover positive paths, validation rejections, and edge cases like blank strings and boundary limits.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Single repo with in-memory storage, no cross-service contracts or persistent data; no architectural decisions needed beyond what the LLD covers.
With analyst requirements, breakdown, and designer LLD in sequence, the cross-check adds minimal value; test_architect already ensures AC coverage.
